name: Bellman
positioning: Le logiciel de syndic et gérance qui redonne du temps aux équipes.
description: Bellman is management software for syndic and property-management firms, born from a former online-syndic startup that pivoted to a software publisher in 2022. It centralises the work of managers, accountants and assistants around an integrated messaging inbox, an extranet for co-owners and the trustee board, and document-automation tools for general assemblies.
description_fr: Bellman est un logiciel de gestion pour cabinets de syndic et de gérance, né d'une ex-startup de syndic en ligne reconvertie en éditeur de logiciel en 2022. Il centralise le travail des gestionnaires, comptables et assistants autour d'une messagerie intégrée, d'un extranet pour les copropriétaires et le conseil syndical, et d'outils d'automatisation documentaire pour les assemblées générales.
real_estate_use: A syndic firm receives dozens of invoices and email requests every day: Bellman automatically attaches them to the right file and lets staff process quotes and condominium documents directly from the inbox, without re-keying. The manager prepares the agenda for a general assembly over the course of the year rather than in a rush, tracks convocation mailings in real time, and records postal votes. The trustee board and co-owners follow the progress of their cases and charge collection from a dedicated extranet, which cuts down on follow-up calls and emails to the firm.
features: Inbox integration for processing invoices and quotes

use_cases.job: Process invoices and quotes received by email without re-keying them into the condominium file
Prepare and track convocation mailings and postal voting for a general assembly
